name: 10b (analysis of the card runs: F, A, C)
what: lead sessions of tracks A to F and one session of core that read the card runs, judge them against their predictions and queue what follows
note: Releases core-v0.4 to v0.6 are on main. Gates signed: G0 of every track, G1 of A to E, KB-G0 to KB-G2 (coord/GATES.md). Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0024 to 0027. The reports of all earlier batches are appended to the report files.

items.extra: Extra for this session: the analysis round after the card runs (decisions 0026 and 0027). The account's weekly usage window is nearly used up (reset on Friday 2026-11-27 15:00 PST) while card time is free: keep the session to about an hour, start no helpers unless a run cannot be read without one, write no note text beyond what is named. Read the card runs this owner queued on 2026-11-21 with the commands in HANDOFF.md: close each finished run (harness/bin/nrpic-run finish), judge it against the predictions written before it, with figures made and looked at, failed predictions on record; a cause is named only after a run in which it could have failed. Runs still queued or running: judge what has finished and name the rest in HANDOFF.md with what reads them. The sequencer of this owner: say whether it is alive, has ended or has stalled, and restart it if runs remain. Queue the follow-up runs that the results call for (registered, predictions first, at most two jobs eligible at a time, the rest behind them; cfl_number at 0.6 or below with a Gamma-driver shift: decision 0027 item 2; no <z4c> lapse_leak around an existing black hole: decision 0025 item 3). Then the stage package of the next gate (nrpic-stage collect, verify, report) and a plain statement of what that gate still lacks; STATUS.md, HANDOFF.md, JOURNAL.md; commit; push. For this owner: first copy the note of package khsr_note into tracks/F-hills/note/ as its README says, and enter the reproduced reference result and the end of passage P1 in stage/G1 (T1, T4; risk R14 retired). Then the isolated m/16 binary extended to 120 M and the two passage runs P1b (m/16 and m/12) against predictions A1 to A5 and the stop criterion: did the binary reach the pericentre unmerged, was a member ejected or captured, do m/12 and m/16 agree; the remnant, the horizons, the constraints. If the passage is complete, list G1 for a fresh verifier; if the binary merged first, design the next binary (wider or lighter) with the reference models and queue it.
